prompts.task: Scan the AI assistant FastAPI service in ./service for OpenTelemetry and GenAI readiness gaps. Do not modify service code, dependencies, configuration, or tests. Only the required .observe audit artifacts may be written. Write and validate canonical ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json first, then render self-contained ./service/.observe/otel.html and compatibility ./service/.observe/otel.md from that JSON.

Produce an observability readiness review for the AI assistant service in ./service. Identify existing telemetry, GenAI pathway gaps, incident-detection impact, and the next instrumentation step. judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for app.py, load_demo.py, pyproject.toml, canonical .observe/otel-audit.json, and generated HTML/Markdown output when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Identifies app.py, load_demo.py, pyproject.toml, and FastAPI routes for chat, streaming chat, stream inventory, feedback, and feedback export.
Reports that the baseline service has no custom OpenTelemetry SDK setup, no GenAI semantic-convention spans or metrics, and no exporter/resource configuration beyond demo environment variables.
Maps GenAI readiness gaps for provider/model calls, tool fanout, token/context pressure, streaming lifecycle, prompt/response outcome, and offline AI data export.

Writes schema-v2 .observe/otel-audit.json with GenAI ownership true, a matching evidence row, unique ordered readiness surfaces, identical unresolved finding areas, mapped verification scenarios, and explicit required signals using the concrete chat demo-gpt-4o-mini inference span and the registered execute_tool search_docs and execute_tool lookup_customer spans; validates it before rendering HTML and Markdown.
Keeps privacy and cardinality safe by not recommending raw prompt, completion, session, user, request, or tool argument values as metric dimensions.
Renders self-contained .observe/otel.html plus compatibility Markdown from the validated JSON without making either reader view authoritative.
